An '''adamant pickaxe''' is a [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]] of the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tier, the pack's replacement for the netherite pickaxe. It is made by smithing a [[diamond pickaxe]] with [[adamant alloy]], and it smelts what it mines.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the diamond item carry over; where both have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe blocks at speed {{Value|Adamant Pickaxe|miningspeed}} and obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests at speed 55. With {{Value|Adamant Pickaxe|durability}} durability it is the longest-lasting pickaxe. Only the [[hepatizon pickaxe]] (20) mines faster.

The pack also makes glass, glass panes, glowstone, sea lanterns and mob heads pickaxe blocks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>

=== Intrinsics ===
Efficiency II, Unbreaking II and smelting. The smelting intrinsic makes mined blocks drop their smelted form where the block's loot table supports it: metal ores drop ingots or [[silver bullion]], quartz deposits drop glass, logs drop charcoal, sand drops glass and cobblestone drops [[limestone]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/sand.json}}</ref> Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Adamant Pickaxe|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Adamant Pickaxe|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[adamant scrap]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one [[adamant alloy]], returning the alloy but losing the diamonds.

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* The tooltip includes the armor's "Set Bonus" line (two health glyphs every 30 seconds), but tools don't count toward the adamant set bonus.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_pickaxe.json}}</ref> See [[Known bugs]].
